描述_EN: it represents another type of chinese burial figures which is slightly less ambitious than the terra cotta armies of the first emperor. this earthenware figure once had detachable wooden arms and clothes made of fabric, both of which have now deteriorated.
描述_ZN: 它代表了另一种类型的中国随葬品，与始皇帝的陶器军队相比，它的野心略小。 这个陶器人物曾经有可拆卸的木质手臂和织物制成的衣服，这两样东西现在都已经退化了。
